espn-604593.headline: Jake White starts where Fiji's last final ended
beats: Fiji picked Jake White, 62, from 31 applicants this month. His first Test is Japan at Prince Chichibu Memorial Stadium, where Fiji lost the Pacific Nations Cup final 20–15 on 19 September.
A year earlier Fiji won the same final, 33–27 against Japan in Salt Lake City. Their one win of 2026 came against Canada, and in July England put 73 on them. Japan arrive on three straight wins.

White ran the Bulls from 2020 to 2025. The Blue Bulls president says "Fiji needs its South African discipline", and Fiji's chairman says White will not kick the flair into touch. Japan will get the first look at which one turns up.
Lose, and Fiji drop below Wales and Italy. Italy are on White's November list, after France and Ireland, so he would have a chance to fix that in person.

sources.title: Rugby-White won't boot Fiji's flair into touch on World Cup quest, says chairman
